chapter: Owls, Werlein's and the OK record
title: Credits and personnel on the record: Dirty Rag
summary: Sharkey on trumpet, writing credits to Bonano, Brownlee and Shields, no bass, Crumby on drums, Eastwood on banjo.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: My first record date: sessions, personnel, discography

blocks.x: Let's see, you had a trumpet too on the records.

I don't think that was Sharky. For some reason, I don't think Sharky. Yes, he was too. Sharky. Sharky made the record. Because we got our names on the numbers. They were mine. Dirty, rag and peculiar. But we put three names, I think, on that. Banana, Brownlee and Shields. I believe that was it. I'm pretty sure that's the way it is on there. Yeah, we put it on there.
And you had a bass player, I guess, huh? Maybe that's it.
Yeah. No. No bass? No, I don't, no. We didn't use bass. Drummer? Yeah, it's Crumbie. Alonzo.
Yeah, Billy Eastwood. Billy Eastwood was on there.
